# Wun-Yi Liang (梁文宜)

> Wun-Yi Liang is a fourth-year student in the Department of Radio & Television at National Chengchi University (NCCU, 政大廣電), Taiwan, focused on video production. Their work spans writing and directing, sound, and cinematography. This site is a personal portfolio with selected works and contact information.

Website: https://my-website-git-main-whitney10.vercel.app/

## About

Wun-Yi collects interesting thoughts from everyday life, combines them with lived experience to build stories, and refines them repeatedly into moving images. The goal is for audiences to experience the kind of laughter and tears that belong uniquely to film and video.

- Name: Wun-Yi Liang (梁文宜)
- Education: 4th-year student, Radio & Television, National Chengchi University
- Skills: screenwriting, directing, editing, sound recording, sound mixing, cinematography, studio audio

## Works

- "INTRO:" — drama short film. Roles: screenwriter, director, editor. Synopsis: on the day before a singing competition, Xiaoman's cold keeps getting worse, and it becomes a way to avoid the stage. Why choose to stay, and what makes someone leave? Video: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1kxvZlEY4UUMkJXP941eZeXjPhoHZR0A7/view?usp=sharing
- "誰是躺分王" — psychological-game reality show. Role: head of the camera (cinematography) team. Tagline: "Everyone hates a free-rider, yet everyone wants to be one." Video: https://youtu.be/46tX9FNVGv4?si=WUBTu4FBAxaLgteX
- "哺哺" — drama short film. Roles: sound recordist, sound mixer. Video: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1xHsBO50oC0E1o9fNU3KAFCmwtruYLtGS/view?usp=sharing
- "火侯" — drama short film. Role: sound recordist. No public link available.
- "留下的房客" — studio live-broadcast program. Role: head of the audio team. Video: https://www.youtube.com/live/mzGxYek5iNA?si=tH-gxGb1WUtxjJ48&t=1538
